environment.description: Kubernetes 1.24 cluster running CI/CD workloads. Pipeline pods run with default ServiceAccount. No PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurity admission controller configured. Nodes use containerd 1.6 with default seccomp profile (unconfined for privileged containers). Pipeline controller creates pods from user-supplied pipeline YAML which can set securityContext.privileged=true and hostPath volume mounts. The plugin binary runs as PID 1 in the container.
